# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's public service broadcasting network, delivering news, culture, and regional content across the United Kingdom and internationally.

BBC operates regional services across Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, and specialized Gaelic broadcasting through BBC Alba and BBC Cymru. The corporation covers diverse content including news, sports (rugby union, Scottish football, Gaelic Games), cultural programming (Doctor Who, traditional Celtic music), and local community stories across the UK's nations and regions.

## Key Topics

- Regional broadcasting
- Scottish Gaelic media
- Welsh-language content
- Rugby union coverage
- Scottish politics and news
- Celtic music and culture
- Doctor Who
- Gaelic Games
- Scottish football
- Ulster news
- Celtic Connections
- Traditional music
- Local journalism
- UK nations coverage
- Public service broadcasting

## Regional Services

- [BBC - Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional homepage: news, politics, football & culture
- [BBC - Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional homepage: news, sport, Doctor Who & local content
- [BBC - Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC NI homepage: Ulster news, Gaelic Games, Radio Ulster & local sport

## Gaelic Broadcasting

- [BBC - Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba homepage: Scottish Gaelic news, culture, sport & broadcasting
- [BBC - Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru homepage: Welsh-language news, Radio Cymru & S4C content
